routes.label: in person at an EBC registration office

note: The EBC's page: a citizen may apply from 15; the card is valid ten years from issue; a replacement costs TT$10 the first time and $20 after (not modelled). The first application's being free is WikiProcedure's (a procedures wiki), the EBC naming a fee only for replacements. The EBC says a first card takes longer than a passport but gives no time, so the time is null.

sources.title: Elections and Boundaries Commission (Trinidad and Tobago), Apply for a New ID
sources.said: A citizen of Trinidad and Tobago, fifteen (15) years and over; ... An Identification Card is valid for a period of ten (10) years from the date of issue. ... The fee for a first issue replacement card is $10.00 (TTD), while a second or subsequent issue costs $20.00 (TTD).

sources.title: WikiProcedure, Trinidad and Tobago - Obtain a National Identification Card
sources.said: There is no charge for your first application for a National ID Card
